commits.subject: Verify dependency hashes when running Python repository tools (#62346)
commits.reason: Use upstream's shared runner for hash-verified Python formatting and SDK schema generation. Keep the fork's source-selected Trust build and scoped upstream formatting rules.
evidence: All five files on integrated source 93787cbdcf match upstream. The runner exports the selected lockfile group, verifies package hashes in a temporary virtual environment, and invokes the chosen tool there. Repository schema refreshes use the runner for Python types. Scratch and experimental exports leave the SDK alone.

Under the protected execution profile, eleven formatter and generation tests passed. The actual runner installed the locked Ruff versions 0.15.13 for repository scripts and 0.15.12 for the SDK. A fresh isolated project with altered package hashes was rejected before Ruff ran.

The locked SDK test group regenerated v2_all.py from the combined stable schema in a disposable source tree. Its SHA-256 ca60032f523568c3b6b1833a582d52158a6dc60800eb5720d964220d0e61cd59 matched the checked-in Python types byte for byte.
